audio.strategy: Three offline recorded banks. Salamander C5 uses five recorded dynamics with crossfades between layers. Upright Piano KW uses two recorded dynamics. Rhodes Mark I uses one recorded dynamic, velocity-sensitive gain and filtering, and the author’s sustain loops at runtime. Nearby roots are transposed during playback. Clavinet, FM Stage Piano, Rosewood Marimba and the fallback are synthesized. Organ and Synth generate audio at runtime and share the piano AudioContext and master limiter. Organ A and B share one effects chain. Piano A/B and Synth A/B/C each have independent chains.

generatedSources: Runtime additive, FM and inharmonic partial buffers for Clavinet, FM Stage Piano, Rosewood Marimba and the piano fallback.
Runtime damped oscillator modes for sympathetic string resonance and seeded impulse responses for reverb.

Organ uses additive tonewheel oscillators with seeded key-click noise and synthesized percussion, transistor waveforms for Vox and Farf, and additive pipe ranks. B3 Bass uses a restricted B3 registration and Pipe 2 uses brighter pipe ranks.

Synth uses Web Audio oscillators, runtime Fourier wave tables for pulse and hard-sync shapes, seeded white noise, and oscillator-to-oscillator FM. Envelopes, filters, LFOs, and arpeggiator/gate run inside the existing instrument graph.
